content: FDR (Fixture Difficulty Rating) is a 1-5 scale per fixture, colour-coded: 1-2 green (easy), 3 grey/yellow (medium), 4 orange (tough), 5 red (very tough). Ticker convention: grid of team rows x GW columns, each cell colored by FDR and labeled with opponent + H/A. Universal convention across FFScout, premierfantasytools, fpl.page, fplcopilot, fpltactics.
